<script>
(function(){
  var g = window.genui || {};
  var DEFAULTS = { monthly: 500, years: 30, ratePct: 5 };
  var state = Object.assign({}, DEFAULTS);

  try {
    var saved = (g.getState && g.getState()) || null;
    if (saved && typeof saved === 'object') state = Object.assign(state, saved);
  } catch (e) {}

  function num(v, d) { var n = +v; return Number.isFinite(n) ? n : d; }
  function clamp(v, a, b) { return Math.min(b, Math.max(a, v)); }

  state.monthly = clamp(num(state.monthly, 500), 100, 3000);
  state.years   = clamp(Math.round(num(state.years, 30)), 5, 40);
  state.ratePct = clamp(num(state.ratePct, 5), 0, 12);

  var $ = function(id){ return document.getElementById(id); };
  var els = {
    monthly: $('sMonthly'), years: $('sYears'), rate: $('sRate'),
    oMonthly: $('oMonthly'), oYears: $('oYears'), oRate: $('oRate'),
    vBal: $('vBal'), vPrin: $('vPrin'), vInt: $('vInt'), chart: $('chart')
  };

  function fv(monthly, months, ratePct) {
    var r = ratePct / 100 / 12;
    if (!r) return monthly * months;
    return monthly * (Math.pow(1 + r, months) - 1) / r;
  }
  function fmt(v) { return '¥' + Math.round(v).toLocaleString('zh-CN'); }
  function shortMoney(v) {
    if (!v) return '0';
    if (v >= 10000) {
      var w = v / 10000;
      return (w >= 10 ? w.toFixed(0) : w.toFixed(1).replace(/\.0$/, '')) + '万';
    }
    return String(Math.round(v));
  }
  function niceCeil(v) {
    if (!(v > 0)) return 1;
    var p = Math.pow(10, Math.floor(Math.log10(v)));
    var n = v / p, s = n <= 1 ? 1 : n <= 2 ? 2 : n <= 5 ? 5 : 10;
    return s * p;
  }

  var W = 640, H = 260, padL = 64, padR = 16, padT = 16, padB = 32;
  var plotW = W - padL - padR, plotH = H - padT - padB;

  function drawChart() {
    var months = Math.max(1, Math.round(state.years * 12));
    var monthly = state.monthly;
    var r = state.ratePct / 100 / 12;
    var N = 120, pts = [], i, m, bal;

    for (i = 0; i <= N; i++) {
      m = Math.round(months * i / N);
      bal = r ? monthly * (Math.pow(1 + r, m) - 1) / r : monthly * m;
      pts.push({ m: m, bal: bal, prin: monthly * m });
    }
    var last = pts[pts.length - 1];
    var maxY = niceCeil(Math.max(last.bal, last.prin));

    function X(mm) { return padL + (mm / months) * plotW; }
    function Y(v) { return padT + (1 - v / maxY) * plotH; }

    function poly(key) {
      var out = [];
      for (var k = 0; k < pts.length; k++) {
        out.push(X(pts[k].m).toFixed(1) + ',' + Y(pts[k][key]).toFixed(1));
      }
      return out.join(' ');
    }

    var s = '';

    for (var t = 0; t <= 4; t++) {
      var v = maxY * t / 4, yy = Y(v).toFixed(1);
      s += '<line x1="' + padL + '" y1="' + yy + '" x2="' + (W - padR) + '" y2="' + yy +
           '" stroke="currentColor" stroke-opacity="0.13" stroke-width="1"/>';
      s += '<text x="' + (padL - 8) + '" y="' + (parseFloat(yy) + 4).toFixed(1) +
           '" text-anchor="end" font-size="11" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.6">' +
           shortMoney(v) + '</text>';
    }

    s += '<line x1="' + padL + '" y1="' + Y(0).toFixed(1) + '" x2="' + (W - padR) +
         '" y2="' + Y(0).toFixed(1) + '" stroke="currentColor" stroke-opacity="0.32"/>';

    var xt = [];
    [0, Math.round(state.years / 2), state.years].forEach(function (yv) {
      if (xt.indexOf(yv) === -1) xt.push(yv);
    });
    xt.forEach(function (yv) {
      s += '<text x="' + X(yv * 12).toFixed(1) + '" y="' + (H - 9) +
           '" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.6">' +
           yv + '年</text>';
    });

    var area = 'M ' + X(0).toFixed(1) + ',' + Y(0).toFixed(1) + ' L ' + poly('bal') +
               ' L ' + X(months).toFixed(1) + ',' + Y(0).toFixed(1) + ' Z';

    s += '<path d="' + area + '" fill="var(--accent,#2563eb)" fill-opacity="0.12"/>';
    s += '<polyline points="' + poly('prin') + '" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" ' +
         'stroke-opacity="0.45" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-dasharray="5 4" stroke-linejoin="round"/>';
    s += '<polyline points="' + poly('bal') + '" fill="none" stroke="var(--accent,#2563eb)" ' +
         'stroke-width="2.4" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-linecap="round"/>';
    s += '<circle cx="' + X(months).toFixed(1) + '" cy="' + Y(last.bal).toFixed(1) +
         '" r="3.5" fill="var(--accent,#2563eb)"/>';

    els.chart.innerHTML = s;
  }

  function syncInputs() {
    els.monthly.value = state.monthly;
    els.years.value = state.years;
    els.rate.value = state.ratePct;
  }

  function render() {
    var months = Math.round(state.years * 12);
    var bal = fv(state.monthly, months, state.ratePct);
    var prin = state.monthly * months;

    els.vBal.textContent = fmt(bal);
    els.vPrin.textContent = fmt(prin);
    els.vInt.textContent = fmt(bal - prin);
    els.oMonthly.textContent = '¥' + state.monthly;
    els.oYears.textContent = state.years + ' 年';
    els.oRate.textContent = state.ratePct.toFixed(1).replace(/\.0$/, '') + '%';

    drawChart();
  }

  function save() {
    try { if (g.setState) g.setState(Object.assign({}, state)); } catch (e) {}
  }

  els.monthly.addEventListener('input', function (e) {
    state.monthly = +e.target.value; render(); save();
  });
  els.years.addEventListener('input', function (e) {
    state.years = +e.target.value; render(); save();
  });
  els.rate.addEventListener('input', function (e) {
    state.ratePct = Math.round(+e.target.value * 10) / 10; render(); save();
  });

  var btns = document.querySelectorAll('button[data-rate]');
  for (var i = 0; i < btns.length; i++) {
    (function (b) {
      b.addEventListener('click', function () {
        state.ratePct = +b.getAttribute('data-rate');
        syncInputs(); render(); save();
      });
    })(btns[i]);
  }

  syncInputs();
  render();
})();
</script>
